tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lcang can gung gi snyan shal zhal byang // sngon gyi las sam 'phral rkyen las/ /gyur pa'i 'jigs dang sdug bsngal rgyu/ /sdang byed dgra yi dmag tshogs dang / /chom rkun gdol pas gtses pa dang / /lus srog nor la gnod byed pa'i/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad dang rims/ /bgegs rigs brgyad khri gdon chen rnams/ /thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /glo bur ye 'grogs gnod pa dang / /byad stims mthu dang 'byung ba 'khrugs/ /mi dang mi min gnod pa kun/ /thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /dus min 'chi ba la sogs pa/ /nyer 'tshe kun las rnam rgyal nas/ /tshe ring nad med dbang thang 'phel/ /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor mthar phyin mdzod// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 klu sgrub/ lcang can gung gi snyan shal zhal byang / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
